test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
The given graph shows the income and expenditure of a family. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b2d6b2cf22087645bbf86501c72cbd08b0af7d450d32ac9da886ba9a854080a.png] 

The expenditure of the family increased by _____ from 2017 to 2018.
solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure of 2017 = 80000

Expenditure of 2018 = 100000

**Formula Used:**

Expenditure increased from 2017 to 2018 = (Expenditure of 2018 - Expenditure of 2017)/(Expenditure of 2017) times 100

**Calculation:**

Expenditure increased from 2017 to 2018 = (100 -80)/(80) times 100

⇒ (20)/(80) times 100

⇒ 25 %

**∴ The expenditure of the family increased by 25 % from 2017 to 2018**
